chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Apply kohl in an odd number of strokes and use the siwak across the width of the mouth."

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, the speaker of this instruction
key_terms.اِسْتَاكُوا: use the siwak for cleaning the teeth

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about applying kohl and using the siwak?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a Prophetic etiquette concerning personal grooming and oral hygiene. It instructs applying kohl in an odd number and using the siwak across the teeth, reflecting refinement and adherence to sunnah.
